description:
Search Man of Many's published articles, reviews and buyer's guides.

    Use for any question about men's lifestyle where Man of Many's take would help: watches,
    style, grooming, cars, drinks, tech, travel, food, gifts. Returns titles, links, authors,
    dates and short excerpts (not full articles). Buyer's guides rank first.

    Args:
        query: what to look for, e.g. "dive watch under $2000" or "best aftershave".
        category: optional section, e.g. Watches, Style, Cars, Drinks, Tech, Grooming, Travel.
        limit: number of results, 1 to 15 (default 8).
name: search_articles
title: Search Man of Many
